## Gait Libraries: Blending and Interpolating
<!-- 1. How are gaits transitioned between? -->

<!-- Six phase videos stacked on top of each other. Each is wrapped in a
     reveal.js `.fragment` div so arrow-right reveals it and
     `startEmbeddedMedia` (which does `queryAll(fragmentEl, 'video')`)
     autoplays the inner video. Each phase's first frame matches the
     previous phase's last frame, so transitions look seamless. -->
<div class="r-stack" style="margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%;">
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="0"><video src="../media/BezierPhaseA.mp4" data-autoplay muted playsinline style="max-width: 100%;"></video></div>
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1"><video src="../media/BezierPhaseB.mp4" data-autoplay muted playsinline style="max-width: 100%;"></video></div>
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2"><video src="../media/BezierPhaseC.mp4" data-autoplay muted playsinline style="max-width: 100%;"></video></div>
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3"><video src="../media/BezierPhaseD.mp4" data-autoplay muted playsinline style="max-width: 100%;"></video></div>
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4"><video src="../media/BezierPhaseE.mp4" data-autoplay muted playsinline style="max-width: 100%;"></video></div>
<div class="fragment" data-fragment-index="5"><video src="../media/BezierPhaseF.mp4" data-autoplay muted playsinline style="max-width: 100%;"></video></div>
